Q: Merge / convert multiple PDF files into one PDF A:

You can see use the free and open source pdftools (disclaimer: I am the author of it).

It is basically a Python interface to the LaTeX pdfpages package.

To merge PDF files one by one, you can run:

pdftools --input-file file1.pdf --input-file file2.pdf --output output.pdf

To merge together all the PDF files in a directory, you can run:

pdftools --input-dir ./dir_with_pdfs --output output.pdf

Q: How do I include a role from another role using dedicated tags? A:

In my opinion, this is a slightly complicated approach. I'd suggest keeping your playbook as the "orchestrator" of what you want configured on the target hosts.

# playbook
- hosts: all

  roles:
    - os-base

  tasks:
    - name: Copy CA certificates to prevent MITM issues
      ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: certificates
        tasks_from: _deploy_ca_certs.yml

Calling role-from-role, playbooks-from-role, using tags, etc. can become difficult to manage in the longer run. Other option if you want to conditionally use specific tasks files is to have a boolean variable that enables the functionality.

# certificate/tasks/main.yml

- name: Install pair of private key, and certificate
  ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
    file: _deploy_ca_certs.yml
  when: deploy_ca

# in playbook
- hosts: all

  tasks:
    - name: Copy CA certificates to prevent MITM issues
      ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: certificates
      vars:
        deplay_ca: true

If your role is dependent on some other role, it is better to use them from dependencies in meta/main.yml.

# os-base/meta/main.yaml

dependencies:
  - role: certificate
    vars:
      deploy_ca: true

Q: I am looking for a GUI tool similar to win32 API Spy for a popular linux distro such as Linux Mint A:

No such thing exists, because "the Linux GUI system" doesn't exist. You will need different tools for different GUI systems.
